system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Detailed prompt templates are provided in the Appendix J.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only. Appendix J is not in the evidence. Templating is inferred from the word 'templates' plus task, tips and working-memory inputs. The listed repo_url (stanford-trinity/artemis) is the ARTEMIS pentest scaffold from arXiv:2512.09882, a different system, so no D-Artemis code was available.

env_context_strategy.note: The manager agent sees the task plus a screenshot ('screenshot only'), and app-specific tips are retrieved from a knowledge base. The retrieval mechanism (lexical or embedding) is not specified. No code or config surface was available.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: To maintain a focus on recent events, it is implemented as a sliding window with a size of five.
context_compaction.note: The step history keeps only the last 5 thought-action pairs plus the latest reflection.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the environment observationO (screenshot only) as input

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: ACTION:Tap on the Timer tab at the bottom of the screen. < click(coordinate=(207, 1621))>
tool_call_format.note: Closest value. Actions are text function-call strings inside angle brackets, and the parser was not seen.

tool_count.note: The action space (click, swipe, type, long press, terminate) is mentioned in Table 3, but there is no tool registry in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: GUI agent. No tool registry was available.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependency list was available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The framework operates on a three-stage lifecycle for each step: action generation, pre-execution alignment, and post-execution reflection.
loop_primitives.note: The per-step loop is react-style. The TAC check followed by ACA correction before execution acts as a verify-repair cycle.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the behavior of manager agent can be modeled as a policy π that maps all available information to a thought-action pair
planning_granularity.note: Only per-step thoughts are described. No plan object is mentioned.

multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed per-step sequence: manager agent, then TAC check, then ACA (conditional), then SRA.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If the TAC check fails (ct = 0), ACA (denoted as fAC) is triggered.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value. A fixed hand-off to specialised agent roles within a step.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The working memoryMt is initialized at the onset of task, comprising two key components: step his- tory and last reflection.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: our knowledge base is designed around app-specific modules of tips.
long_term_memory.note: Closest value. A predefined, static tips knowledge base is retrieved per app. It is not learned across runs (the Limitations section notes this as future work).

self_verification.evidence_quote: we train a TAC check module. This lightweight expert model acts as an efficient filter
self_verification.note: The SRA also judges step effectiveness after execution (Sec. 3.3).

termination_condition.note: A Terminate action exists. Step caps are not reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: an online mobile agent benchmark that runs in a live Android emulator
execution_isolation.note: This is the evaluation environment (AndroidWorld emulator), not a harness-defined isolation boundary.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on AndroidWorld and ScreenSpot-V2, but no D-Artemis repo was available to check for a built-in runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The Thought- Action Consistency Check (TAC) module serves as a pre-execution safeguard.
guardrails.note: Actions are validated and corrected before execution.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a novel frame- work designed for complex mobile GUI automa- tion tasks

open_source.note: The repo_url points to ARTEMIS (Stanford pentest scaffold, arXiv:2512.09882), not D-Artemis. No D-Artemis licence was available.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B- Instruct (Bai et al., 2025) and GUI-Owl-32B (Ye et al., 2025) as the base models
model_agnostic.note: Two different base models are used. No client abstraction was seen.

primary_artifact.note: The only D-Artemis artifact is the paper. The linked repo belongs to a different system (ARTEMIS). The record needs a manual check of the identity mismatch.

first_release_date.note: Only the v3 date (7 Jan 2026) is in the evidence. The v1 date and tags are not available.

stars.note: No gh api result was provided, and the repo_url does not match the system.
